Thanks for the details. Billing notes and options below — TL;DR: we cannot perform a direct ledger move between two distinct org IDs in our self-serve tooling without formal verification; however we can do an expedited reissue to the correct workspace immediately if the customer opts for that.

Option A — Reissue via promo code (fast):
- We revoke the promo from the guest workspace and generate a new promo code tied to ws-acme-prod-77. The customer redeems the code and sees the balance immediately. No org-level transfer logged in ledger, but outcome is the same for usage.
- Requires: confirmation of target workspace ID and an acknowledgement that the promo code will be redeemed into Acme-Prod. Estimated time: same day.

Option B — Manual org-to-org ledger transfer (audit trail):
- Requires: signed request from an Acme org owner + proof of ownership for both org IDs. Will be processed by finance ops and appears as an internal ledger adjustment.
- Estimated time: 24–72 hours depending on verification.

Given the pilot timeline, I recommend Option A unless the customer explicitly needs a ledger transfer for accounting reasons. If they want the transfer, we'll kick off the verification checklist (I can send the template).

Please confirm which flow to trigger and provide the exact workspace ID (ws-acme-prod-77) + contact. If we go Option A, I can generate the promo code and hand it back to you.

-dev
